tool_suggestions.title: Recruiter Performance Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create a dashboard that allows HR managers to track recruiter performance, using data such as placements and ratings.
features: View recruiter placement statistics and rankings
Flag recruiters with low performance for further review

tool_suggestions.title: Job Posting Management Interface
tool_suggestions.prompt: Develop a multi-page tool for creating, updating, and reviewing job postings to streamline company hiring operations.
features: Create and edit detailed job postings
Monitor the status and progress of job openings
Assign recruiters to specific job postings
Generate reports on job posting performance

tool_suggestions.title: Candidate Interview Coordination System
tool_suggestions.prompt: Design a system to coordinate candidate interviews, integrating schedules and feedback to optimize workflow.
features: View candidate interview history and feedback
Aggregate interview feedback for decision making
